en: A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a gently curving road lined with 2–3 story wooden buildings with shop awnings on the left and trees and fencing on the right. Several pedestrians, including children and adults, walk along the street while a horse‑drawn cart stands further back. The word "Elverum." is printed at the top center of the image, and there are small numbers at the bottom edge typical of early photographic postcards.
